 Concert Music Festival 
 Concert Music Festival 2027: Miguel Campello, God Save the Queen and the Kyiv Ballet go on sale this Friday; the line-up night by night
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Clara Belmonte 
 20 Nov 2026, 11:00 
 A 4-minute read 
 Concert Music Festival 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Miguel Campello, God Save the Queen and the Kyiv Ballet are on sale from 12:00 this Friday on Ticketmaster: they perform on Thursday 29 July, Sunday 8 August and Sunday 15 August in Sancti Petri. 
 Concert Music Festival 2027 now has nine nights with named artists , from Saturday 17 July with Camilo to Tuesday 17 August with Lucho RK, including two nights of David Bisbal, La Oreja de Van Gogh and Melendi. 
 Four of those nights were previously sold blind under the “invisible artist” scheme , and anyone who bought for them now knows what they have got; 13 dates remain without a name, at €27.50. 
 The three new additions now have prices : standing for Miguel Campello costs €27.50, for God Save the Queen €38.50, and the Kyiv Ballet ranges from €55.10 to €69.30; for the rest, the cheapest ticket ranges from €38.50 for Lucho RK to €60.50 for standing at Camilo and La Oreja de Van Gogh. 
 A singer-songwriter who blends flamenco and rock, a Queen tribute and Swan Lake . The three latest dates of Concert Music Festival 2027 went on sale on Friday 20 November at 12:00 and broaden the Sancti Petri line-up, in Chiclana de la Frontera (Cádiz), beyond the Spanish-language pop that underpins it. With them, the festival now has nine nights with an artist between 17 July and 17 August, and some of them had previously been sold without a name.
 Festival guide 
 Concert Music Festival 2027 
 Dates to be confirmed · Poblado de Sancti Petri, Chiclana de la Frontera 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 Campello, God Save the Queen and the Kyiv Ballet: the three nights going on sale today
 All three are sold on Ticketmaster , the channel the festival's website links to:
 Thursday 29 July, 22:30. Miguel Campello . The former singer of El Bicho presents Flamencura , his new album and the tour of the same name, which according to the ticket listing blends flamenco rhythm with world music. Concert with a standing floor and numbered stand seating.
 Sunday 8 August, 22:00. God Save the Queen . The Argentinian Queen tribute band, with Front Stage and a standing floor, as well as stand seating.
 Sunday 15 August, 22:00. Swan Lake, by the Kyiv Ballet . Viktor Ishchuk's Kyiv Ballet brings Tchaikovsky's ballet to the festival. It is the only one of the three nights sold entirely as numbered seating , from the front rows to the stands.
 God Save the Queen perform in Sancti Petri on Sunday 8 August. Image: Concert Music Festival. All three share the same conditions as the rest of the season: under-16s are admitted with their father, mother, guardian or a responsible adult, and 16- and 17-year-olds can attend on their own. Tickets for people with reduced mobility are requested by phone, on 930 49 75 00.
 The Concert Music Festival 2027 line-up, night by night
 This is the calendar of concerts with named artists, according to the festival's website and the venue's listings on Ticketmaster:
 Saturday 17 July, 22:30 : Camilo , on a tour that takes in several summer festivals in Spain .
 Saturday 24 July, 22:30 : David Bisbal , first night of the Tour Eternos.
 Sunday 25 July, 22:30 : David Bisbal , the second date the festival added in October .
 Thursday 29 July, 22:30 : Miguel Campello. New .
 Sunday 8 August, 22:00 : God Save the Queen. New .
 Tuesday 10 August, 22:00 : La Oreja de Van Gogh , with their 30th anniversary tour, which also stops at other festivals .
 Friday 13 August, 22:00 : Melendi , one of the five festival stops of his summer .
 Sunday 15 August, 22:00 : Swan Lake , by the Kyiv Ballet. New .
 Tuesday 17 August, 22:00 : Lucho RK , who put three festivals in the south on sale on Thursday .
 Until this week, the line-up was a string of mainstream Spanish-language pop names, the same formula as in 2026, with Pablo Alborán, Chayanne and Lola Índigo. The three additions change the tone: a singer-songwriter with flamenco roots, a tribute act and a night of classical dance, two of them on Sundays. All the practical information about this edition is on the Concert Music Festival page .
 Four nights that were sold blind now have a name
 29 July and 8, 15 and 17 August were on sale under the Invisible artist promotion, which sells a ticket for a date without saying who is performing. None of those four now appears on the list. According to the terms published by the festival, that ticket gives access to the event held on the chosen date, so anyone who bought blind for those nights now knows what they will see: Campello, God Save the Queen, the Kyiv Ballet or Lucho RK. Seats are allocated by the organisers, and there are no exchanges or refunds even if the artist does not appeal.
 13 dates remain on sale, at €27.50 on the Ticketmaster listings : 9 and 16 July, and 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11, 12, 14 and 16 August. The 14 August date is shown with limited availability.
 Other nights on the original list have been withdrawn without an announced artist. 30 July joins those that had already disappeared in October: 10, 23 and 31 July, and 6 August. There is a precedent: 13 August was also withdrawn from the promotion before the festival announced Melendi for that night. The festival has not said whether those dates are being held for new names.
 Prices for the nine named nights
 Since 12:00, Ticketmaster has been showing prices for the three new nights. Including the booking fees Ticketmaster adds, the cheapest ticket for each concert costs:
 Miguel Campello : €27.50 for standing and €33.10 for the stands.
 God Save the Queen : €38.50 for standing, €44.10 for the stands and €49.50 for Front Stage.
 Kyiv Ballet : between €55.10 and €69.30, depending on the area.
 Lucho RK : €38.50 for standing and the stands in the first release; Front Stage, €66.
 Melendi : €55.10 for standing, €71.50 for the stands and €82.50 for Front Stage.
 David Bisbal : from €55.10 for a category E seat on the night of the 24th, up to €132 for premium seats. His concerts are all-seated.
 Camilo and La Oreja de Van Gogh : €60.50 for standing, €82.50 for the stands and €99.10 for Front Stage.
 Terraces for four people and boxes for six are sold separately and range from €630, for the terrace with drinks at Lucho RK, to €2,800, for the box at Camilo, Bisbal or La Oreja de Van Gogh. The €27.50 invisible artist ticket now costs the same as standing for Miguel Campello, the cheapest named ticket of the summer; the difference is that with the former you do not know who will take the stage.
